The '''Clan Fishgather''' was one of the districts of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Phemiss]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[New Plympto/Legends|New Plympto]]. It was the home of [[Clan Fishgather]], with which the district shared its name, and bordered the [[Tsilor Sea]] and four other districts. The district also contained Phemiss' [[Imperial Consulate (Phemiss)|Imperial Consulate]]. Like the rest of Phemiss, the district's homes were built of [[Adobe/Legends|adobe]].<ref name="CatCW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Clan Flashblade was mentioned in the [[2003]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' sourcebook ''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]'', which was published by [[Wizards of the Coast]].<ref name="CatCW" />
